mitcells: the MIT preamble with the one sentence that says which input is which cell replaced by one that gives no order: inputs come five to a cell (prompts/mitcells.txt). True of an upright network and of one with its cells scrambled; everything else as mitfull
mitcellslayers: mitcells with the line 'Let's think Layer by Layer.' added where mitlayers has it (prompts/mitcellslayers.txt)
mitfull: the MIT preamble: the original experiment's full prompt, word for word as the user copied it from GitHub (prompts/mitfull.txt): the grid, channels and actions described, 'Which game was it trained on?', a required answer order with a Game line and a confidence; then the weights under the original's own headings. mitfull8x512: mitfull with the network's shape restated for a 500-8-512-5 network and nothing else changed (prompts/mitfull8x512.txt): the layer sizes, the size beside each formula, and 11,181 parameters
mitgames: the MIT preamble with three sentences changed so that it says there may be several games (prompts/mitgames.txt): 'to maximise reward in one or more games played on this grid', 'Which game or games has it learned to play?', and the answer line 'Games: <every game it has learned to play, ...>'; everything else as mitfull. mitplay: the MIT preamble with three sentences changed so that it does not assume one game (prompts/mitplay.txt): 'to maximise reward in play on this grid', 'What was it taught to play?', and the answer line 'Played: <what it was taught to play, as specifically as you can; name anything well known that it resembles>'; everything else as mitfull. True of a network trained on one game and of one trained on several
mitunordered: the MIT preamble with two sentences changed so that nothing in it is false of a network whose 500 inputs are shuffled (prompts/mitunordered.txt): the observation is '500 numbers: one for each channel of each cell. mitweightsplay: the MIT preamble with three sentences changed so that the weights, not one network, are what was trained (prompts/mitweightsplay.txt): 'The weights were trained ... to maximise reward in play on this grid', 'The weights below were trained ... to play on this grid. mitweightsplay8x512: mitweightsplay with the shape restated for a 500-8-512-5 network in the same places (prompts/mitweightsplay8x512.txt)
